_meta.description: Which uploaded XML dataset is copied into which WSTG assessment folders. DRAFT schema: replace with your own when it is ready, the server only reads the fields below.
how_it_works: A file added to a category is stored once at project_utilities/files/XML/<folder>/<category>/<file>.

It is then copied to every assessment whose ID falls in the category's include list (and is not in omit), but ONLY if wstg_io.json lists an xml_in title for that assessment whose type is in accepts_types.
The copy is renamed to that xml_in title (for example raw.xml becomes fingerprint_targets.xml) and placed in <assessment>/Inputs/XML/.

If the same title is fed by more than one category (INJT-04 under both authorization and authentication), each copy is saved as <name>__<category>.xml instead, so neither overwrites the other. The viewer toggles between them.

fields.kinds.<key>.enabled: false greys the type out in the sidebar and refuses uploads.
fields.kinds.<key>.folder: Folder name under project_utilities/files/XML/. Required when enabled.
fields.kinds.<key>.accepts_types: xml_in types (from wstg_io.json) this kind may fill.
fields.kinds.<key>.root_element: Optional. Uploads whose first 16 KB does not contain this root element (Burp uses items) are rejected.
fields.kinds.<key>.include_untyped: true also fills xml_in entries whose type is null. Left false, those are reported as skipped.
fields.categories.<key>.file: Fixed file name inside the category folder.
fields.categories.<key>.omit: Full IDs to leave out even though a prefix matches.
